dayTask.title: A Custom KB Chatbot
dayTask.description:
Build a Knowledge Base chatbot that indexes local markdown files and answers user queries using vector embeddings.

### Objective
1. Set up a vector storage pipeline (ChromaDB or FAISS).
2. Implement similarity search for incoming queries.
3. Wrap the response in a streamlined UI layer.
dayTask.postTemplate: Day 12/60 of the #60DayCodingChallenge complete! 🚀 Built a custom KB Chatbot indexing local markdown files with vector search. Check out the repo!
